name: qa-manual-testing
description: Manual and exploratory testing: scripted test cases, session-based exploratory charters, decision-table and state-transition test design, and bug bashes. Covers SBTM, Whittaker's tours, Bach and Bolton's heuristics, UAT scripts, and PROOF debriefs. A critic agent (test-script-quality-critic) flags vague preconditions and bundled steps in authored scripts.
